name: Day of Reckoning
description: After each life comes death, and the promise of new life that must be nurtured.
effect: Followers of Yveltal may call upon 'Day of Reckoning' once per quest as a bonus action during their combat turn, allowing them to apply up to +5 flat damage to their next damage roll (before defense calculations, but after critical hits). For each tick of additional damage, the user of this boon sacrifices 1 HP (up to 5 HP total). If this Damage would KO them, the attack is completed then they are KOed. They can take damage into negative HP values for this Boon, however, any negative HP they take from this boon's usage lowers their Max HP by that same amount for the duration of the quest. If the user would be KOed by using this Boon, then the triggering Move has High Critical. If the User would use a Draining Move, they do not regain HP from the Move while using this Boon. At each rank beyond Initiate, gain the ability to sacrifice 1 more HP for 1 more damage. HP is increased by one per rank.
